title: Chapter 183: Substitute Straw Doll
content:
Chapter 183: Substitute Straw Doll

But all this was in vain. Some of the arrows missed, some were swept away by weapons, and some were blocked by sophisticated armor. They did not cause much damage at all. A few horses were hit by flying arrows, but they could still charge.

Ayub and Wang Shuo found Zhao Tianze's position and ran straight to him.

This frightened Zhao Tianze so much that he panicked and rushed to the center of the archers.

Several sturdy men around him protected him heavily.

But it was useless!

The cavalry charge was not something that these low-level archers could resist.

The formation was quickly torn apart, and the archers fell like wheat.

At this moment, Zhao Tianze bent his bow and shot an arrow, and an arrow flew towards Wang Shuo at a rapid speed.

Wang Shuo saw from a distance that the bow and arrow used by Zhao Tianze was one size larger than the bows and arrows used by ordinary archers, and the arrows were also thicker.

For safety reasons, Wang Shuo directly activated the "Flame Shield" for defense.

Instantly, a light golden shield appeared on his body, protecting his entire body.

The brown arrow hit the shield, generating a huge impact force, almost causing Wang Shuo to fall off his horse.

Fortunately, Wang Shuo's horsemanship level has been raised to level 4, otherwise he might have been shot off the horse.

Seeing that the shot missed, Zhao Tianze's pupils suddenly expanded, with a look of disbelief on his face.

You know, this arrow once killed a bronze boss's health by one-third.

It was actually missed by Wang Shuo.

He was in a bad mood.

But Wang Shuo didn't give him time to be depressed.

After knocking away the big man who was guarding him, Wang Shuo and Ayub directly used a spear and a long sword to lift Zhao Tianze up.

Raised in the air.

He was really panicked now.

Wang Shuo directly retracted the spear, held the spear with both hands, and stabbed forward with force.

The spear entered his chest.

The cold spear pierced his chest, and he felt his breathing was short, and the severe pain in his chest made his brain go blank.

Zhao Tianze felt the threat of death!

Like a drowning man, his eyes were full of fear, and his limbs were sore and weak.

He wanted to shout for mercy, begging Wang Shuo to let him go.

But before he could open his mouth, Ayub's Qinglong knife chopped directly at his neck.

Suddenly, the head fell to the ground.

What surprised Wang Shuo was that Zhao Tianze's body, at this time, strangely scattered into light spots and disappeared.

And in the original place, there was a palm-sized straw doll, with its head and body separated.

In the territory not far away, Zhao Tianze's figure slowly emerged.

He was sweating on his forehead, and it was obviously not good.

"Ah!"

"Wang Shuo, I want you to die!"

He roared angrily, and then coughed.

Obviously, he had just escaped through the straw doll, but it was not without cost.

The violent coughing made him spit out a mouthful of blood.

Wang Shuo naturally understood that this straw doll and the resurrection coin had the same purpose.

He could only say inwardly: "What a pity."

Then, the battlefield fell into a melee.

This result was not what Wang Shuo wanted to see.

The cavalry continued to charge, while Wang Shuo and Ayub rushed directly towards Zhao Tianze regardless.

The two of them, relying on their high level and good equipment, did not have too many concerns on the battlefield.

Moreover, they had the water of life to save their lives, so as long as they were not killed instantly, there would be no problem.

The two rushed into Fengze Village, and the surrounding Fengze Village residents immediately fled in all directions.

There were no other soldiers around Zhao Tianze.

He was like a frightened bird, and immediately summoned his mount and fled in the opposite direction.

Behind him, Wang Shuo was chasing closely.
